notes.title: Upcoming levels - The Tower
notes.content:
[b]Hi folks, team Fat Walrus here![/b]

Here is a small announcement of upcoming levels for "Why is the Princess in a Magic Forest?!" 

We are currently working on 10 new levels, part of an all new stage called "The Tower!" We hope to release the levels in December or January. Of course, all for free to everyone who owns the game!

[h1]Details[/h1]
-Stage name: The Tower
-Levels in stage: 10
-Difficulty rating: 3 stars

[h1]Current progress:[/h1]
-Level design [i]100% completed[/i]
-Graphical assets [i]80% completed[/i]
-The Tower interface elements [i]0% completed[/i]
-Level testing [i]0% completed[/i]

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26710427/6abaf5896ccc4cd9d8c0d7c2170fd12dfb90f75f.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26710427/8e27c13729f3ed4b011068fa65c22e70647f7d8b.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Sorry guys, we got a slight delay
notes.content:
Team Fat Walrus here! 

It seems we made a mix-up with our common redistributables, so our application is under review again. Sorry for the delay, but we will make the game available as soon as we manage to clear this last hurdle!
